conditions.rule: Diagnose possible sexual assault
conditions.quote: forced into sexual act (excluding penetration) without consent

conditions.rule: Diagnose possible rape

judgment_calls.decision: One 5-day onset window for everyone, because the language cannot express patient sex.
judgment_calls.alternatives: A 3-day window for everyone (under-triages women at 3-5 days); dropping the criterion.

judgment_calls.decision: "Victim of sexual aggression" (finding) as the trigger; "Victim of rape" is its descendant and matches. Possible diagnoses of these two findings for the page's "Suspect sexual assault/rape" sentences also trigger the task and the priority rule.
judgment_calls.alternatives: "Sexual assault" / "Rape" event concepts; "Alleged victim of sexual assault" (situation).

judgment_calls.decision: Any "Traumatic injury" counts; "needing attention" is not representable.

judgment_calls.alternatives: An Emergency/Very urgent priority for severe bleeding, strangulation etc.; the page does not state a higher priority.
